source: User-reported NOVA scores; no scored encounter transcript supplied
changes: An affirmative answer to an onset question gets one bounded clarification, within the existing three-turn clarification cap
A bare yes/no/unknown is not recorded as the onset value; the latest substantive onset reply is summarized
An explicit mismatched teach-back time is corrected once even when the plan was already spoken
Practical return-visit barriers receive a planning response; filler does not repeat an already delivered plan
limitations: No live Doctor or organizer run
Historical synthetic development cases are not an independent blind set
